history.summary: DUPLICATE FLAG: this row ('Tapkeshwar Mahadev Temple') is the same temple as seq 1106 (id tapkeshwar-temple-dehradun), which documents it in full under the name 'Tapkeshwar Temple' with 'Tapkeshwar Mahadev Temple' as an alternate name. It is the famous cave Shiva shrine at Garhi Cantt, Dehradun: a natural self-manifested shivalinga inside Drona Cave, with water continuously dripping from the cave ceiling ('Tapak' = drop by drop). Legend: Guru Dronacharya meditated here; his infant son Ashwatthama was fed milk by Shiva dripping from the cave roof. Pilgrims bathe in sulphur springs nearby. Annual Tapkeshwar Mela at Shivratri. town_description: Dehradun is the capital city of Uttarakhand, set in the Doon Valley at the foothills of the Himalayas. Known as the 'School Capital of India' with institutions like The Doon School and the Forest Research Institute, it is also the gateway to the hill station of Mussoorie and a base for Char Dham pilgrims.

travel.road: Garhi Cantt area, about 6.5 km from Dehradun city centre; motorable road to the site followed by a short walk to the cave
